_comment: Hand-checked boss mechanics, merged into plugins/boss-telegraph/bosses.js by build.py.
Each one only puts into words what the game already shows a sighted player: the boss's
line, its cast bar, the colour it glows and the buff icon on it with its time.
trigger: cast (09 38, the cast bar starts), use (02 38, the skill goes off) or abnormal
(2A 38, a buff lands on the boss). phase: the buff the boss gets from it and how long it
lasts; when it ends (2C 38, or its length runs out) the plugin says 'safe' (words.safe).
lead: ms from the trigger to when it hits, shown while the call is up (0: no countdown).
Confirmed in captures 2026-10-26 (tools/boss-telegraph/README in the plugin's README).
